user.title: Connect to Refoss
user.description: Sign in to your Refoss Cloud account.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The password for your Refoss account ({email}) is no longer accepted. Enter it again to reconnect the integration.

reconfigure.title: Update Refoss credentials
reconfigure.description: Enter the email address and password for the Refoss account. Use the same account to keep the existing devices and entities.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.description: Your Refoss account ({email}) requires a verification code. Enter the current code shown in your authenticator app.

data_description.mfa_code: Enter the current code from your authenticator app. The code changes regularly.

error.invalid_mfa: The verification code is incorrect. Check the code and try again.
error.mfa_required: Refoss still requires a verification code. Enter the current code from your authenticator app.

abort.already_configured: This Refoss account is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: You must sign in with the same Refoss account that is already configured.

invalid_auth.message: Your Refoss credentials are no longer valid. Re-authenticate your account.

cannot_connect.message: Unable to reach Refoss. Home Assistant will retry automatically.
